title: How to communicate with the seller on aliexpress.com
description: In this video video, we will tell you how to properly communicate with sellers on AliExpress.

asr.full_text: How to communicate with a seller Hello, in this video I will tell you how to communicate and why to communicate with a seller? Do I need to communicate with a customer via Aliexpress? Yes, and this is a very solid guarantee for an successful transaction process In what cases should I contact another customer? It is recommended to talk with someone about all the information prior to booking your order What is the target of my communication with the seller? The main goal is to collect all necessary information about the selected seller or product at the preliminary stage of creating the order. Check to identify how reputable a buyer is, whether he is ready to ship you the product and at what speed he responds to your requests. What to do if the seller is silent and doesn't contact you? It is not recommended to make any order, especially to pay an order of such a seller. What are the terms of receiving an answer from a seller? You cannot use your phone, as it will work automatically without your presence in contact with it. Such orders cannot be implemented, especially until you pay them. The orders will have to be returned to you online. If you wait one day, with an average of only two to three days, they may change any time. You can also make sure that your service provider's orders don't fit into the system by the time the store opens. what can I tell my chosen salesperson about? Are there or are not needed items on seller's store yet before placing their order in the bag or the payer is chosen by you to clarify the products options fit the description sizes, clothes size, equipment opportunities to get discounts remember, that it's better to raise questions, to get answers on time and before deciding the contract and availability of the deal, the possibility of getting discount, dates such as shipping, and so on. Remember that it is better to ask the buyer question and the answer must be given timely till the end of the deal between you and the seller. Who to communicate with is preferred in English, but at least it can be with Chinese or Russian speakers. To do so, one should ask the seller if he'll be able to take part in your conversation. Make note that the last two languages are available only in direct dialogue within the manager. What to do if I don't know any foreign language? Consider that the last two languages may only be used when communicating in a chat window. What to do if I don't know a foreign language? Go online to Internet of Resource, check it out, it's a Google translator. To communicate properly. Be polite and considerate, follow the rule and be proud of your partner. Start to communicating with a good impression of a good or a greeting word. Avoid ambiguous words and phrases. Write the words to just the sentence as if it's when you're talking, let's say, with a child. It is good to say Hello or Hi Don't use too much words and phrases Please write simple words You are telling people that you are having a bff Explain it in the standard, understandable, simple and approachable way Be sure to thank your salesperson for his answers And all of his assistance And say good bye to your customer after the interview What approach can I use? There are only 4 main ways of communication available. Email The first and simple and easy to understand and familiar communication with email. Password of call in the message box during the selection of the selected box or item at the upper right corner. The most accessible but the longest way. The vendor can not have internet or e-mail access to email. The language of communication is English. The second way will be contact with the seller through any free access on Internet or internet. Your language is English. The 2. Communicate with a salesman through an open shop or order page At the shop or order page click Contact now Fill in the form that appears on the plate. Confirm information here and click Send. Just wait for a response and then send the same message center in the personal office. Receiving the customer's reply one may ask him another question or ask him about another matter. Method number 3. The principle of a re-consultation in an open order is similar to the following ones as mentioned above. In the corresponding area of a rectangle you write the item you consider necessary, for example, an explanation to your order – color, number, size and more. The plus of this correspondence is that it can be presented as the evidence base for discussion and disputes. Seller's answers can be read in the detailed viewing mode of your order. Method number 4. Communication between the seller and the broker This application has to be downloaded and installed on your computer. Application for using it for those who have communication skill via Skype or Iceki, for instance, won't be difficult. The only drawback of this program is that it doesn't have a Russian-language web interface. By default, the interface menu has English language. However, Kirillets and his Chinese messages are supported by the app. To those of you who are experiencing some difficulties with using this app or its installation, I recommend you use the app a seller described to me earlier. You can download the program at trendmanager.aribaba.com. If the supplier is not on the internet, you can save a message that he sees when the next time goes out chat. To find out the history of your message in Trend Manager, follow the following. Go to the History section in the Menu section. Click all messages. Select the contact with whom you choose your recent contact. In my opinion, the most effective way to communicate with a trade manager is by the way... you have been talking to me about earlier.

textual.observation: The source links communicating with a seller through AliExpress to a claimed guarantee of a successful transaction process and recommends communicating before placing or paying for an order.

evidence.quote: Yes, and this is a very solid guarantee for an successful transaction process
It is recommended to talk with someone about all the information prior to booking your order

textual.context: Presented as instructional guidance about communicating with sellers; whether the guarantee is literal, qualified, or merely imprecise wording is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed transaction outcome is linked to the requested action of communicating through AliExpress before ordering, which may require later assessment of what assurance is actually being offered.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that communication guarantees a successful transaction, nor do they establish any loss, deception, or harmful outcome.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source warns viewers not to order or pay when a seller is silent or does not make contact.

evidence.quote: It is not recommended to make any order, especially to pay an order of such a seller.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an instructional guide about gathering seller or product information and avoiding payment when a seller does not respond. The AliExpress contact-form and trade-manager material supports a tutorial about messaging sellers through commerce-platform tools, rather than a solicitation for money or credentials.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central context is an ordinary commerce tutorial about communicating with sellers, checking product details, discussing shipping and discounts, and using a marketplace contact form. The evidence does not establish that the external seller or platform is safe or unsafe.
